The Kottavalasa–Kirandul (KK) Railway Line is one of the most challenging railway corridors in India, passing through the rugged terrain of the Eastern Ghats.
In this video, I return to the ground at Chimidipalli to document the latest progress of the KK Line Doubling Project, where a new railway track is being developed parallel to the existing operational line.
